name: Order Watch
tagline: Follows your parcels across retailers and only speaks up when a delivery needs you
description: A delivery watchdog that sits over a connected inbox, following parcels and their order updates across several retailers. When a status looks ambiguous it asks you a clarifying question first; otherwise it says nothing until something genuinely needs your attention. Quiet by design, never another source of noise.
author: gokul_i
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
